skill.summary: Local speech-to-text with the Whisper CLI (no API key).

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of openai-whisper-hardened.

- Provides local speech-to-text transcription using the Whisper CLI (no API key needed).
- Includes quick start usage examples for transcription and translation tasks.
- Implements security guardrails to prevent network transmission and protect sensitive audio sources.
- Recommends using the `whisper` CLI and outlines safe model and performance options.
- Models are downloaded locally on first use.
